 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Singh, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Abhay Kumar , App
 =====================================================

=
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
3 03-01-2025
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State .

Despite valid service of notice, nobody appears on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
2.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 341 ,
498A, 323 , 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3 . As per F.I.R., the daughter of the complainant was married with this petitioner and after the marriage, when she went to her matrimonial house, she was subjected to torture and cruelty by this petitioner and other in-laws family members due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry and lastly,
she was Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.55208 of 2024(3) dt.03-01-2025 ousted from her matrimonial house .

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner, while denying the allegations made in the F.I.R., submits that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case merely because he happens to be husband of the victim.
However, he is ready to keep the victim with full honour and dignity.

He further submits that petitioner filed a petition for restitution of conjugal life u/s 281 of Muslim Law on 11.09.2023 before Md. Sanjur Alam vs The State Of Bihar on 3 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26251481/
1

sentences.text: the learned Principal Judge Family Court Katihar vide Matrimonial Case No. 466 of 2023 and thereafter the present F.I.R., has been lodged on 29.09.2023 .
Moreover, the case is triable by the learned Magistrate.
The petitioner has further relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182 .

sentences.text: 5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from today, let this petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned SDJM Katihar in connection with Azamnagar P S Case No. 346 of 2023 , subject to the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.55208 of 2024(3) dt.03-01-2025 conditions, as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure .
